data.gender_notes: Ruddy is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'rūd', meaning 'red'. In the Bible, Ruddy is a name given to Esau, the older brother of Jacob, who was described as having a red complexion. This name can be seen as a symbol of strength and determination. The name Ruddy carries the meaning “Red, ruddy complexion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ruddy usually hope their child will grow to embody red, ruddy complexion and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ruddy total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ruddy" holds cultural significance outside of its biblical roots. In ancient Rome, a Rudus was a mound of earth or rubble built for public works or ceremonial purposes. This use of the word may also contribute to the association of strength and power with the name.
data.spiritual_significance: In the context of the biblical figure Esau, the name "Ruddy" can be seen as a reminder of God's sovereignty in the lives of individuals. Despite Esau's physical redness representing the birthright being passed to his younger brother Jacob, God's plan was ultimately fulfilled through Jacob. Thus, the name "Ruddy" serves as a reminder of God's power to work all things together for good. (Romans 8:28)
